text_block_list.name: Close-up Staff
text_block_list.text:
"In-Depth Documentary Umamusume Film: 
Duramente", Vol. 2~!

text_block_list.name: Close-up Staff
text_block_list.text:
Today we are following Duramente-san on 
her rest day, but... We heard you already 
have a clear destination in mind?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yes. —Today, I intend to go confirm my own 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Close-up Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oh, strength! ...Alright! Gym, waterfall 
meditation, mountain climbing! No matter 
how tough it gets, I'll keep up with you!

text_block_list.name: Close-up Staff
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, a park? Could it be that you do 
some special training here...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: No. I am going to see a tree up ahead.

text_block_list.name: Close-up Staff
text_block_list.text: Huh, a tr...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Well, if it isn't Dura. What a 
coincidence... Are you filming for that 
documentary?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...It is the season for this tree to 
bloom, so I came to see it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Same here. I had some business nearby. 
...It's in magnificent bloom again this 
year.

text_block_list.name: Close-up Staff
text_block_list.text:
If I recall correctly, this commemorative 
tree was presented by the nation... to 
Duramente-san's family in honor of their 
world-class athletic achievements...

text_block_list.name: Close-up Staff
text_block_list.text:
And the two of you have known each other 
since childhood, having attended the same 
sports academy... right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Together at the development 
academy run by my mother. I believe this 
commemorative tree was gifted right around 
that time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I still remember it. The day Dura, 
knowing my passion for gardening, 
introduced this tree to me.

text_block_list.name: Young Dura
text_block_list.text:
An important person gave this to me 
earlier. Because my father and family were 
so amazing.

text_block_list.name: Young Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see. This is a sturdy species, so it 
will surely grow tall and strong.

text_block_list.name: Young Dura
text_block_list.text:
Really? ...Then I'll grow just as strong 
and grand as this tree!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ever since, I've come to check on it from 
time to time. ...It has grown remarkably 
large.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Unbroken.

text_block_list.name: Close-up Staff
text_block_list.text: Eh?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Like the branches of this tree, unbroken. 
From my father, mother, grandfathers, and 
grandmothers... our lineage's "strength" 
has connected and blossomed.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: And that "strength" is my "strength."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I have been blessed more than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Once again! That very same family claims 
gold yet again~~! A truly overwhelming 
lineage of the 'Strongest'!!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Right beside me was a refined "strength" 
to strive for.

text_block_list.name: Medalist Relative
text_block_list.text:
"Listen well, Dura. Your body is your 
greatest asset in anything you do. Let's 
forge a body resilient against injury."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I was born into a position where I could 
absorb accumulated wisdom of "strength" 
from an early age.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: A proven "crystallization" of strength.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: That is who I am—"Duramente."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I am strong. There is not a single shred 
of doubt in that.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Should I ever betray that expectation... 
...it would be entirely due to my own 
negligence.

text_block_list.name: Close-up Staff
text_block_list.text:
I see... Carrying those feelings, that is 
why you live so stoically every day.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If it's you, you will surely accomplish 
what must be done. ...Together with this 
tree, I shall be watching over you.

A few days later, the day after the 
documentary broadcast aired, I came across 
Duramente and the others.

A few days later, the day after the 
documentary broadcast aired, I came across 
Duramente and the others.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. ...Dura's answers during the 
interview felt quite well-composed too.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ! Truly?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It brought back memories of 
childhood. Back when you weren't used to 
cameras and hid behind me—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Please forget about that.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well, yes. We've known each other a long 
time, sure... Above all else, I have high 
regard for her capabilities.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...! Sister Groove...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... The fact you still haven't 
dropped that nickname is proof enough of 
how long we've been together.

Including the final episode broadcast at a 
later date, Duramente's close-coverage 
documentary concluded to massive critical 
acclaim.
